title: Apollo 11 post-flight press conference looks deceptive

tellings.quote: Watch the Apollo 11 postflight press conference. Watch it. It's like a hostage video.

plain: The Apollo 11 astronauts looked like they were hiding something at their press conference after returning from the Moon in 1969, says the comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan. He tells Michels to watch it, calling it "like a hostage video", and he leans on what an unnamed body language expert said about it. If true, the first men on the Moon would have been holding back part of what happened there.
